name: TOI-2015
description: Star of 3,297 K, 47.3 parsecs away, with 1 transiting planet.

radius.source: Barkaoui et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2015 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive

text.card: TOI-2015 b crosses TOI-2015 as seen from Earth, which is how it was found.
text.introduction: Its radius and temperature follow Barkaoui et al. 2025.
